race.comment: SIMPLY FRIENDS (2) won by a space two back then gave a start but got home into the frame when third at this track (19.75) last time. Expected to feature in the finish again. WINE LOVER (5) flew the lids from out wide with an impressive turn of foot before finishing third (19.47) and beaten 1.75 lengths over 350m at this track. Recorded one of the quickest times on the card last start despite being beaten. Hard to beat again. YEAH YOU (1) turned in a solid run last start over 350m at this track finishing 4th and beaten only 3.5 lengths (19.73). Has ability and can atone. SHOW BOAT JOHNNY (8) is worth consideration after filling a hole at this course and distance last start.
